attempt.method: macOS NDK 26.1 build, targeted ADB upload, one invocation of upstream historical GPU probe, device timeout 8 seconds, post-test health and BL checks, remove uploaded binary
attempt.sourceChanges: none; upstream source and header compiled unchanged
attempt.exitMeaning: The upstream probe has an infinite observation loop; device timeout terminated the test at 8 seconds. This is not an unlock error code.
attempt.interpretation: Output matches neither upstream README expectation, 0 0 nor 41414141 42424242; it establishes neither vulnerability presence, patch status, nor arbitrary memory-write access.
attempt.kernelDiagnostics: dmesg returned Permission denied; kernel logcat with kgsl/Adreno tags returned no entries. No full bugreport or general logcat collected.
attempt.conclusion: The prerequisite GPU probe actually ran, but did not establish exploitability; no root was obtained and BL remains locked. No successful no-wait unlock chain for this device is verified. Neither the full Quest root program nor NO_AVB partition modifications were executed.
